cohort: The study included 141 lactating women aged 15-47 years who were inpatients in the Gynecology Ward at District Head Quarters Hospital, Sheikhupura.
finding: The study found a statistically significant association between Upper crossed syndrome and Neck pain in lactating women.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the Neck disability index.
cross-section timing: During the lactation period (specific timing postpartum not mentioned)
